title: Ling Yuan Appears
next_chapter_hook: After Ling Yuan departed, Chen Ji felt a strange sense of crisis arise in his heart—he could not foresee this person's future

text.content: The setting sun sank beyond the horizon, dyeing the stone bricks of the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena in a blood-red hue. Chen Ji stood at the edge of the crowd, his expression calm as usual, the gray robe of a servant fluttering slightly in the wind. The seemingly precarious victory in the earlier match was merely a deliberate flaw he had left—letting his opponent think he had barely escaped, when in fact everything was under his control. Yet in that instant, an inexplicable chill ran down his spine. Looking up, the highest tier of the stands was empty. That black-robed figure had vanished without a trace.

"Interesting"—those four words seemed to still echo in his ears. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his fingertips gently rubbing against the fragment hidden in the hidden pocket within his sleeve. The Tianji Record had not warned him today, yet an inexplicable pressure poured down from above. This sensation... he had touched that complete page countless times in his dreams, always waking at the most crucial moment. And now, this pressure was eerily similar to the suffocation in his dreams.

dialogue.content: Young friend, enjoying the sunset alone here is quite refined taste.

text.content: The voice came from behind, unhurried, carrying a hint of vicissitudes. Chen Ji turned to see a black-robed elder standing three zhang away, his face gaunt, his eyes deep as an abyss. He wore the robes of a Tianqing Sect Elder, yet his aura was terrifyingly restrained, as if what stood there was an ancient well with no bottom. The elder narrowed his eyes slightly, examining the servant disciple before him, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: I am Ling Yuan, a presumptuous addition as the sect master of Tianqing Sect. Passing by the Martial Arena today, I found that match quite interesting, so I watched for a while.

text.content: Ling Yuan. Chen Ji's heart trembled slightly, but his expression revealed nothing. This legendary old sect master of Tianqing Sect, usually lived in seclusion, appearing and disappearing like a divine dragon, with most young disciples in the sect having only heard his name but never seen him. Yet now, this figure standing at the pinnacle of the cultivation world had actually approached a servant disciple like himself. When things are abnormal, there must be demons. He bowed respectfully, his voice neither humble nor overbearing: "Disciple Chen Ji greets the sect master. With the sect master occupied with countless matters, to still pay attention to such an insignificant match is this disciple's great fortune."

dialogue.content: Insignificant? Ling Yuan laughed lightly, "Those moves of yours, seemingly desperate, were actually perfectly timed at every step. This sense of proportion is not something an ordinary servant possesses." His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, as if admiring an interesting toy, "I am rather curious though—how did a servant disciple like you cultivate such skill?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, but he put on his usual simple smile, scratching the back of his head: "Reporting to the sect master, this disciple grew up in the mountain wilderness since childhood, so his body is still quite sturdy. Daily I chop wood and carry water, occasionally spar with the brothers, practice makes perfect." His tone was sincere, his eyes clear, exactly like a country boy who had never seen the world. Yet in the moment his words fell, his peripheral vision caught a flash of sharp light in Ling Yuan's eyes—that was the glint of a hunter seeing prey.

dialogue.content: Practice makes perfect?" Ling Yuan stepped forward slowly, "In all my years, I have never seen anyone perform 'desperation' so naturally." He stopped two steps before Chen Ji, his surrounding aura suddenly pressing down, "Young friend, there is something I do not understand—during that match, you could have won in three moves, why did you drag it to the seventh move?"

text.content: A faint pressure permeated the air, the aura accidentally released by a Foundation Building pinnacle cultivator. Chen Ji felt his chest tighten, his breathing slightly hindered. He knew this was Ling Yuan testing him. If he showed even a trace of flaw now, everything would be in vain. He raised his head, meeting those deep-as-abyss eyes, his lips curving slightly into a somewhat cunning smile.

choice.prompt: Facing Ling Yuan's interrogation, Chen Ji must make a choice—continue the disguise, or appropriately reveal his strength?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, turn the tables
choices.description: Use rhetoric to counter-question Ling Yuan, forcing him to expose his true purpose while maintaining a low-profile persona
choices.visible_cost: May arouse deeper suspicion from Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily prevent Ling Yuan from determining your true capabilities
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely deep and scheming; if the rhetoric is exposed, it will be very passive

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a hint of simplicity and confusion: "The sect master is insightful, this disciple has truly only practiced some rustic moves, how could I understand any techniques? Just now that senior brother struck fiercely, this disciple only thought of protecting my life, how could I bother counting moves? If not for good luck, I would have been down long ago."

choices.text: Face the aura directly, reveal a hint of sharpness
choices.description: Appropriately release aura, letting Ling Yuan witness part of the strength, but still with reservations
choices.visible_cost: Expose some trump cards, may attract more attention
choices.visible_reward: Deter the small fry, making Ling Yuan look at one with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: Showing too much brilliance will make Ling Yuan even more wary,会带来无穷后患

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, the spiritual power within his body quietly circulating, his surrounding aura suddenly changing. That originally weak aura revealed a trace of sharpness, like a sword leaving its sheath. "The sect master is right, this disciple has indeed been hiding my inadequacy." His voice remained calm, yet carried an undeniable weight, "But this disciple dares to ask—with all due respect, why did the sect master specifically come find a servant disciple today?"

choices.description: Maintain a low profile, use humility to dissolve Ling Yuan's probing, seek opportunities to escape
choices.visible_cost: Be suppressed in aura, may lose face
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, save for a future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Being overly weak will make Ling Yuan despise you even more, making it harder to turn the tables later

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the surging spiritual power within his body, donning once again that simple and honest appearance. He stepped back, bowing deeply: "The sect master's教训 is correct, this disciple was wrong. This disciple should not have shown off in front of the sect master, in the future I will certainly be cautious in words and actions, and never trouble the sect master again." His posture was extremely low, like a child who had done something wrong.

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, examining this young man before him. After a moment, he suddenly laughed, that laughter low and profoundly meaningful. "Interesting, truly interesting." He raised his hand to strike, five fingers like hooks, directly grabbing Chen Ji's shoulder. This grab seemed casual, but actually harbored secret intricacies, the spiritual energy within three zhang was all drawn by this grab, forming an invisible cage. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, his body本能地做出闪避动作—动作快得连他自己都吃了一惊.

Oh? Ling Yuan's eyes blazed with brilliant light, his five fingers suddenly accelerating, fingertips almost brushing Chen Ji's sleeve. At the critical moment, Chen Ji ducked low, slipping through the gaps between those five fingers. He stumbled back two steps, his face full of astonishment, but his heart was clear. In that instant, his body had reacted faster than his consciousness—that was an instinct honed through countless life-and-death moments, absolutely not the speed a servant disciple should have.

dialogue.content: This footwork..." Ling Yuan withdrew his hand, his gaze becoming sharp, "I have misjudged. A servant disciple actually has such skill. You, exactly who are you?"

text.content: Chen Ji stabilized his form, his mind calculating rapidly. Ling Yuan's test had already revealed seven or eight tenths of the truth. Hard denial would not work, but revealing everything would be tantamount to seeking death. He took a deep breath, a bitter smile appearing on his face: "The sect master is insightful, this disciple indeed has... some unspeakable encounters. But this disciple bears no second heart toward Tianqing Sect, everything I have done is merely for self-preservation." He raised his head,直视凌渊的双眼,"If the sect master insists on pursuing, this disciple has nothing to say."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan already senses something amiss, how will Chen Ji respond to this final interrogation?

choices.description: Reveal part of the truth (the existence of the Tianji Record Fragment), but hide key details
choices.visible_cost: May attract Ling Yuan's coveting of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Trade a small secret for great safety, making Ling Yuan temporarily back off
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan sees through the lie, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content: Chen Ji took the corner of that fragment from his sleeve, waving it briefly before Ling Yuan's eyes, then put it away. His movement was swift, like a thief being overly cautious, yet precisely allowed Ling Yuan to glimpse that corner of the ancient paper. "Sect master, please do not spread this around." He lowered his voice, "This disciple obtained it by chance, not daring to show others. Begging the sect master for mercy, give this disciple a way to survive." That posture was extremely humble, but deep in his eyes, a faint cold light flickered.

choices.text: Refuse to budge, stick to the story
choices.description: No matter how Ling Yuan probes, firmly insist it was just luck and quick reflexes
choices.visible_cost: May be当场揭穿 by Ling Yuan, completely losing face
choices.visible_reward: Guard all secrets, leave no handle
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely scheming, biting too hard反而显得心虚

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, an innocent look: "Sect master消怒, this disciple really is just a servant. That footwork... is probably just天生反应快吧?" He scratched his head, "This disciple has been called a freak since childhood by the village people, they say my reflexes are abnormally fast. If the sect master does not believe, this disciple can do nothing about it." That expression was sincerely flawless,活脱脱一个被冤枉的老实人.

Ling Yuan did not speak, just静静地地看着陈机. That gaze seemed to want to see through him, see through to his very bones. After a long while, he suddenly sighed deeply, withdrawing his aura. "Forget it." His voice carried a sense of indefinable meaning, "Today I came merely out of curiosity既然. Since the young friend does not wish to speak, I will not force anyone."
Chen Ji felt relieved,正要道谢,却听凌渊继续说道:"不过——"老者绕着他缓步而行,声音low如夜风,"老夫倒是想提醒小友一句。"他停在陈机身后,压低了声音,"这世上有些东西,不是你能染指的。一旦沾上,便是万劫不复。小友,好自为之。"

The words fell, and Ling Yuan had already floated away. Chen Ji stood in place, watching that black-robed figure disappear into the twilight, his back already soaked with cold sweat. He could be certain that Ling Yuan had seen through something. But this old fox did not make a move, instead speaking such profoundly meaningful words—what mystery lay within?

dialogue.content: By the way—" Ling Yuan's voice drifted from afar, carrying a strange smile, "There is an aura on you, very familiar. Like... very very long ago, someone's scent. Young friend, you truly do not have the surname Chen, do you?

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered violently. Those words were like a heavy hammer,狠狠砸在他心口. His origins had always been a taboo he did not wish to touch. His adoptive father, before dying, only left behind the words "You are not a person from Chen Village," then passed away. And Ling Yuan's words about "someone's scent"—exactly what did they mean? Twilight deepened, only he remained standing in the Martial Arena, coldness rising from the soles of his feet, surging directly to his forehead.

He closed his eyes, attempting to mobilize the power of the Tianji Record, wanting to peer into Ling Yuan's past and future. However, the runes on the fragment merely flickered faintly, then dimmed. What replaced it was an unprecedented sense of chaos—like a layer of fog shrouded Ling Yuan's figure, making his fate's trajectory become blurred and unclear. The Tianji Record... actually could not calculate this person? Chen Ji opened his eyes, a trace of solemnity flickering in his gaze. He knew that from this moment, there was one more opponent on the chessboard he could not see through. In the distance, twilight completely devoured the horizon. The bells of Tianqing Sect rang悠悠, declaring the end of the day. And Chen Ji knew that his true game had just begun.
